items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian modern farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, tidy and organized, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, warm white walls, sage green, brass and black metal accents, soft natural daylight. A spacious double-sided walk-in closet seen from the doorway, looking straight down a clear central aisle about 3 feet wide: white built-in closet system on both long walls with hanging rods of neatly hung clothes on wooden hangers, open shelves of folded sweaters, a row of drawers, shoes on slanted shelves, a runner rug on oak floors, a window with a sheer curtain at the far end, a brass pendant light. The aisle between the two sides is clearly wide enough to walk and turn.
